pr_title: Fix bug filtering issues which have no project
pr_body:
Fix #31327
This is a quick patch to fix the bug.
Some parameters are using 0, some are using -1. I think it needs a refactor to keep consistent. But that will be another PR.

issue_context.title: Issues -> Project -> No project filter doesn't work
issue_context.body:
### Description

https://demo.gitea.com/Snuupy/test/issues?q=&type=all&sort=&state=open&labels=&project=-1&assignee=0&poster=0

all issues (even those assigned to a project) are listed (although the issue counter does update to the correct number)

label filters are working, project filter on "No project" are not.

Confirmed as a bug here: https://discord.com/channels/322538954119184384/322538954119184384/1250076856418439289

### Gitea Version

1.23.0+dev-201-g6106a61eff, 1.22.0, 1.21

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes
